query: Please implement an OA maintenance and form development system for designing and managing process forms. The system should have functionalities for process form interface design, control application, process and permission setting, process condition and flow logic sorting, and more. Users should be able to design and manage process forms, set processes and permissions, manage process conditions and flow logic, and implement connections and trigger references between forms and processes. Set overall background to alabaster, then style components with dark cyan.
